commands.name: headroom
commands.description: inline-headroom stats: effort clamps, cache-hit drops, volatile prompt values, compression savings

tools.name: headroom_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve original uncompressed content that was compressed to save tokens. Use this when you need more data than what's shown in compressed tool results. The hash is in compression markers like <<ccr:abc123def456 40_rows_offloaded>> or hash=abc123def456.

children: volatile shared values: unavailable (Claude Code keeps plugins out of the system-prompt hooks)

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: ./register.ts hooks: session.start, command.run{command=headroom}, ui.render{component=Pane, requestId=headroom}, ui.close{id=headroom}, tool.call, session.append{door=tool-result}, session.compact, turn.step, tool.check, turn.complete, session.end, prompt.compose

./register.ts hooks on session.compact, prompt.compose do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them
